detail.longDescription: Just got this absurd e-mail from XBOX Game Pass. Conveniently sent at 8pm (central). This is the final straw, whoever is coming up with these decisions needs to be stoned in the streets. We're making changes to how cloud gaming is included with your XBOX Game Pass subscription. Beginning in November, XBOX Game Pass subscriptions will move to a set number of cloud hours each month, based on your plan. You can manage or cancel your subscription through your Microsoft account here, explore all available plans here, and learn more about how to cancel your subscription here. What's changing Beginning in November, XBOX Game Pass plans will include the following amount of cloud playtime: • Game Pass Ultimate: 15 hours each month • Game Pass Premium: 10 hours each month • Game Pass Essential: 5 hours each month Additional options to purchase cloud hours will be available for players who need them – we'll share more details before this update takes effect.
